description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {1}, targeting any creature you control.
Shimmering Wings enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {2}.
Activate Shimmering Wings' second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
